name: HealthStrip
description: Wrapping row of broker-health chips. Renders only chips that have their minimum samples (chip.render) and hides entirely when none do. Composes each chip's monospaced value (heap folds in its peak; rate chips carry a /s suffix). Chips wrap onto further rows when the window is too narrow for them all, with the row gap matching the chip gap.

props.name: health
props.description: HealthChip[] from the store; only entries with render:true are shown.

notes: Figma is not linked yet; stories use local health-chip fixtures. Stickiness and the capability-notice fallback are owned by BrokerStatusView, not this component.
